children: The current rise in long-term bond yields is caused by higher supply of the debt by governments and companies, as well as expectations of higher inflation, European Central Bank's governing council member Emmanuel Moulin said on Tuesday.
He added that despite the bond yield increases, the French treasury has not had any difficulty raising funds in its most recent debt sales.
Given the current market situation, governments must put their act together and reduce their deficits in a credible way, Moulin added in a press conference held in Paris.

title: Higher debt sales, rising inflation expectation push long-term yields up, ECB's Moulin says
